navigation_policy.search_entry: Open the home page first, then use the visible search UI. Do not open /search?query URLs directly.

common_flow: Open the search UI using the visible search icon or search text.
Type the user query and submit with enter when the search input is focused.
On search results, identify visible job cards and plan a top-to-bottom unvisited-card traversal.
Open one unvisited job card by job title, not by reward badge, tag, or generic icon marker.
On detail, expand '상세 정보 더 보기' when present.
Scroll down until no new useful job body content appears.
Return to the results list and continue with the next unvisited card.

collection_policy.finish_condition: All planned visible cards have been visited or no new unvisited cards are visible.

known_pitfalls: Detail pages may hide body text behind '상세 정보 더 보기'.
Search results and job card order change over time.
OCR may mark a whole card as a generic interactive icon, so preserve the LLM-selected job title as target_label.
